title: Learn visual representations without class labels
subtitle: Train a small masked-image model, then compare pixel reconstruction, teacher predictions, and feature prediction.
audience: Students who know image patches, ViT encoders, softmax, and gradient-based learning
centralLabel: Where the training target comes from
central: \begin{gathered}\text{image}\;\longrightarrow\;\text{hide or transform}\\\downarrow\\\text{predict a target from the image}\end{gathered}

DINO: a teacher supplies the target

provenance: All drawings are teaching illustrations. The MAE-style experiment trains a disclosed 72-parameter model on eight repeated-tile images and evaluates six held-out brightnesses. Browser predictions use saved parameters. The separate DINO calculator uses illustrative logits; it does not run a trained DINO model.
